 Barstool Sports hosting college football show at Elicit in Manchester 
 Excitement building for UConn-UMass Friday night By Rob Polansky and Owen Kingsley Published : Oct. 21, 2026 at 9:33 AM EDT | Updated : Oct. 22, 2026 at 5:52 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MANCHESTER, Conn. (WFSB) - Barstool Sports is bringing its college football show to Elicit Brewing in Manchester on Thursday.
 Barstool said it’ll be a pregame tailgate ahead of the UConn vs. UMass football game on Friday.
 Barstool Sports said it is bringing its college football show to Elicit Brewing in Manchester on Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026. (REGAN COMMUNICATIONS GROUP, INC.) It said Barstool personalities will be at the brewery to talk about the game, and hand out swag and a chance to go backstage at the Barstool College Football Show during the game itself.
 Elicit said the event runs from 7 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. Thursday at the brewery on Adams Street in Manchester.
 Admission is complimentary; however, the event is for folks ages 21 and up.
 UConn takes on UMass Friday at 7 p.m. at Rentschler Field in East Hartford.
 Barstool Sports’ Dave Portnoy explained his reason bringing the show to Connecticut.
 “Growing up, northeast, UMass, UConn,” Portnoy said. “They do not like each other. These are like bitter, bitter rivals.”
 “It’s crazy. I see those guys on my Instagram all the time. It’s like, I never expected them to come to UConn. You’ve got the bigger schools, like the SEC schools, but like, UConn? It’s like crazy,” said Randy Mirander, a UConn senior.
 “I feel like Barstool representing UConn is also a big step. Usually, they do like big schools like Alabama, stuff like that. But I feel like representing UConn can really bring UConn to light. Just like the basketball team does,” said Garrison Nanke, a freshman.
 Portnoy said he expected it to be a cool Friday night environment.
 The Huskies are coming off a big win over Temple on October 10th and have a 3-3 record. They have beaten the Minutemen in their last three matchups.
 The all time record between the schools stands at 38-38-2.
